description: Assemble a tailored CTO 14-Day AI Governance & Seam Charter Pilot scoping dossier matching engineering team size, repository LOC, languages, sector, and compliance constraints to Step-0 air-gapped diagnostics and executive briefings. Example: team_size=45, sector='regulated' returns a custom fintech/regulated scoping packet. Use when scoping Gantlett Systems for a specific engineering team or brownfield monorepo. Do NOT use when browsing raw briefing abstracts by keyword (use search_executive_briefings instead).

compliance_focus.description: Optional compliance or air-gap constraint (for example SOC2, EU AI Act, air-gap).

languages.description: Primary codebase languages (for example Go, TypeScript, Python, Java, Rust).

repo_loc.description: Approximate repository or monorepo lines of code.

name: build_seam_pilot_dossier

briefingUrls.description: Matched Gantlett executive briefing Markdown twin URLs.

canonicalUrl.description: Canonical documentation or twin URL for citation.

title: Assemble CTO 14-Day Seam Pilot Dossier
